title: Distinguish proposed entities from existing implementation
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can explicitly distinguish new or proposed technical entities from existing implementation so plans can describe future work without misleading people or AI about what exists.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A new or proposed System or Component can be recorded and referenced in a design before it has code evidence.
Entity documentation, deck references, and CLI queries expose the explicit new/proposed designation rather than infer it solely from absent code.
An entity known to exist but lacking linked evidence is distinguishable from proposed work; missing, stale, or unresolved evidence remains visible and does not prove implementation.
Later addition of code evidence preserves the prior proposed definition and does not silently rewrite the committed plan.
